candidates.name: Pyoderma gangrenosum
support_spans: new-onset flulike symptoms followed by low-grade fever, facial crusted plaques, and 4 weeks of bloody and watery diarrhea
6 × 7-cm well-demarcated vegetative crusted plaques on the bilateral cheeks
Discrete pustules, vesicles, and umbilicated papules on cheeks and temple
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of flulike illness, fever, and crusted plaques on the face, along with the presence of pustules, vesicles, and umbilicated papules, are consistent with Pyoderma gangrenosum.

candidates.name: Inflammatory bowel disease
support_spans: 4 weeks of bloody and watery diarrhea
Colonoscopy: Moderate inflammation, edema, erosions, and pseudopolyps in the sigmoid colon
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of bloody and watery diarrhea, along with the colonoscopy findings, are consistent with Inflammatory bowel disease.

candidates.name: Sweet syndrome
support_spans: Intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils
Septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas
candidates.why: The patient's histopathological findings are consistent with Sweet syndrome, which is characterized by neutrophilic inflammation.

support_spans: Painful subcutaneous nodules over lower extremities
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms of painful subcutaneous nodules are consistent with Erythema nodosum.
